queries.open_interest: SELECT ts AS decision_time,sum_open_interest FROM open_interest_binance WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND period='5m' AND ts>=:start AND ts<:end AND extract(hour FROM ts)=0 AND extract(minute FROM ts)=0 AND extract(second FROM ts)=0 ORDER BY ts
queries.bars: SELECT date_bin('1 day',ts,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00')+INTERVAL '1 day' AS decision_time,(array_agg(open ORDER BY ts))[1] AS daily_open,max(high) AS daily_high,min(low) AS daily_low,(array_agg(close ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS daily_close,sum(power(ln(close/open),2)) AS minute_squared_return,count(*) AS source_rows,count(DISTINCT ts) AS distinct_rows,min(ts) AS first_ts,max(ts) AS last_ts,bool_and(open>0 AND high>0 AND low>0 AND close>0 AND high>=greatest(open,close,low) AND low<=least(open,close,high)) AS coherent FROM bars_binance WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND interval='1m' AND ts>=:start AND ts<:end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
